trigger: I am being stopped from practising my religion
description: What to do if you are prevented from worshipping or observing your faith.

steps.text: You have freedom of thought, conscience and religion, including worship and observance (s.38).
Ask on what specific legal basis you are being restricted.
Some limits can exist by law for public order or the rights of others (s.45); ask if that is claimed.
Do not respond with force; keep a record of what happened.
Note who restricted you, where, when, and any witnesses.
Report the matter to the NHRC or a lawyer.

citations.source_name: 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
